name: Barzillai
bio: Barzillai the Gileadite, from Rogelim, was among those who brought beds, food, and supplies to David and his exhausted people when they reached Mahanaim fleeing Absalom's rebellion, joining Shobi son of Nahash and Machir son of Ammiel in this timely provision (2 Samuel 17:27-29). Barzillai's continued generosity toward David, and David's gratitude toward him, are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
